behavior: Exceptions, cancel and email are proven on Anvil: partial top-up, expired partial, late, cancel, and each email once (PLAN 9.8, phase 9 gate)
acceptance: backend-e2e runs partial → top-up → paid → settled; expired partial → held with nothing settled and held equal to the receiver balance; late → held; cancel → later deposit held, nothing settled (R-83)
Each owner email and the payer receipt reach the fake sender exactly once, also across a worker restart (R-83)
notes: 2026-10-15 review pass by independent reviewer: Gate proves R-83. Baseline passed 6/6 (~8 s); TestMoneyLoop passes with its 429 and other checks kept. Mutations in a scratch copy, each caught: Canceled removed from ledger.Final (held never booked, timeout); expiry book off (B held 0, timeout); published_at not set after send (98 sends, repeated email); worker clears published_at at start (repeat after restart); no paid after top-up (A never settled); expiry held email dropped (5 of 6, timeout). Restart is real in practice: 4 emails before stop, 2 after, in 5/5 runs. Minor: (1) exceptions_test.go:117 does not wait for any email before stopWorker, so a slower delivery would make the restart prove nothing; add waitFor len(mail.mails())>=3 first. The stop is SIGINT (clean), not a crash between Send and published_at. (2) Changing the Idempotency-Key to a random value per send still passes: mailbox ignores the key; only notify_test.go:117 covers it. Assert keys are unique and stable, or dedupe by key like Resend. (3) Ignoring the late flag in split still passes: C is held through Final(Expired); late alone is covered by ledger unit tests. (4) RESEND_API_URL is not validated; it only matters with a key and env access. (5) gate_test.go:47 append(st.loop, EXECUTOR key) writes into the array the worker's cmd.Env shares (cap 8). The worker already started, so the key does not reach it. Same pattern as before; slices.Clip in newStack would remove it. Scratch removed, no Anvil left.

2026-10-15 review pass by independent reviewer: Re-review of d9f149b. Gate passed 3/3 with TestMoneyLoop (about 8 s and 5 s). Note 1 fixed: the test waits for 4 emails before stopWorker. With Canceled removed from Final it now fails at that wait (exceptions_test.go:118). A worker that clears published_at when it starts fails with a repeated email. Note 5 fixed: slices.Clip on loop. Note 2 partly fixed. A key with no invoice in it (k-<time>) fails at exceptions_test.go:198. A key without the event id fails, because paid and settled then share a key. My first mutation still PASSES, so the claim that it now fails is wrong. That mutation keeps forwend-<invoice>-<event>-<addr> and adds -<time.Now> on each send. Each send is still unique and has the right prefix, so the gate cannot see that the key changes between attempts. Without a retry, the gate cannot test that. No test anywhere checks that a retry reuses the first attempt's key: notify_test TestDeliverRetriesWithBackoffThenGivesUp checks attempts only. That is R-80 (F183) scope, not R-83, so it does not block this pass. Smallest fix: in TestDeliverRetriesWithBackoffThenGivesUp, record the key of the failed send, then let the retry succeed and check the key is the same. Notes 3 and 4 left as agreed. Scratch removed, no Anvil left, repo unchanged.

proof.1: backend-e2e: TestExceptionsCancelAndEmail on Anvil with the real api, worker and signer: A partial -> top-up -> paid -> settled; B expired partial held 1.00 with the receiver holding 1.00; C late deposit held 5.00; D canceled then paid, held 5.00 and still canceled; one settlement intent (A); chain balances equal the ledger's held amounts
proof.2: backend-e2e: a fake Resend gets exactly six emails, none twice, each with its own Idempotency-Key naming its invoice; four go out before a worker stop and start, two after; TestMoneyLoop still passes on the shared newStack setup
